id: title:jurajmajerik:emit one prompt fetched event per labeled list request

review.posthog_relevance: Billing and event accounting: P1.F1.H2 and P1.F1.H4 change the ingestion path to record one event per API request rather than per prompt, while P1.F1.H3 removes the removed payload construction. This could prevent billing and event count inflation for teams using the LLM prompt list endpoint.
review.reason: The diff removes a batched, per-prompt event capture and replaces it with a single event per request, while removing the payload construction that would have supplied per-prompt properties. This is a substantive, bounded change to billing and event accounting. No tier 3 systemic risk or tier 1 maintenance-only behavior is demonstrated. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.
review.uncertainty: The tier relies on the supplied hunk observations; no independent verification of billing or event accounting behavior is available. No tier 3 systemic risk or tier 1 maintenance-only behavior is demonstrated. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaced per-prompt batched capture with a single capture per request, removing the per-prompt iteration and batch construction.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes billing and event accounting: the LLM prompt list endpoint now records one event per API request rather than one event per returned prompt, preventing N prompts from billing N events into the calling team's project.
